jei.obsidiplates.players: Obsidian pressure plate: only players press it. Wool underneath makes it silent; glowstone and quartz make it shrouded (nearly invisible). Smelting turns it back into a plain plate.
jei.obsidiplates.mobs: Mossy pressure plate: only mobs press it, never players. Wool underneath makes it silent; glowstone and quartz make it shrouded (nearly invisible). Smelting turns it back into a plain plate.
